name: B10-0091/2025 (Renew) – Case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is asking Algeria's government to free the writer Boualem Sansal, who is 75 and ill, and everyone else held for speaking their mind. It also asks Algeria to change its penal code to protect press freedom, let foreign journalists work freely, and follow United Nations recommendations and a human rights treaty it has signed. The Parliament also criticises Algeria's shrinking media freedom and a party reform that could end multi-party politics.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only asks Algeria to act.
- It affects detained writers and journalists, and Algeria's government.
- Next, the text goes to Algeria's Parliament and Government in Arabic.
